class C<T> {
  static value: T;
}
class Box<T> {
  static identity(value: T): T {
    return value;
  }
  static own<T>(value: T): T {
    return value;
  }
  static {
    let pending: T[] = [];
    console.log(pending);
  }
  static get first(): T | undefined {
    return undefined;
  }
  static nested() {
    const echo = (value: T) => value;
    return echo;
  }
  item?: T;
}
function outer<U>(u: U) {
  class Inner {
    static keep(value: U): U {
      return value;
    }
  }
  return Inner.keep(u);
}
const Anonymous = class<T> {
  static value: T;
};
console.log(C.value, Box.identity(3), Box.own("s"), outer(1), Anonymous.value);
